title: Tuesdays with Morrie
author: Mitch Albom
summary: Journalist Mitch Albom reconnects with his former professor Morrie Schwartz, who is dying of ALS. Over their Tuesday visits they talk about love, work, regret, family and how to face death.
readIf: you want a warm, reflective book about mortality and what matters in life.
skipIf: you find sentimental reflections hard to take or want to avoid stories about terminal illness.
